race.comment: Very open race. LOS PADRES (1) has impressed at both runs this prep. Came from last in a small field last start to be beaten narrowly over 1150m at the Grange circuit. Very fit now and his record at 1200m is enviable. CHEMTRAIL (7) appreciated the drop in class when a game winner over 1100m at Goulburn last time out as a $1.45 pop. Yet to fill a placing in four runs at this trip which is a concern, but Danny Williams has him going well. BRUTAL BELLE (12) came from last on the corner to record a barnstorming first-up win over 1000m at Canberra recently. Often fails to follow it up at the second run back which is a worry, but over an extra 200m today she must be considered. Genuine four-year-old ABOVE THE LAW (4) is back after a five-month break. Placed at both previous first-up appearances and has also been in the money in his two runs here at 1200m. Should come back in a positive fashion.
